procedure: Ran generate.py once in a scratch copy; validated each emitted file with `cargo run --locked -- --validate --model` (snapshots) or `--bundle` (bundles).
Both snapshot cases were rejected: `invalid_system at /system_id: root must be an internal scope with subtype system`.
Corrected generate.py so the snapshot root scope carries subtype `system`, as public/schema/architecture-format.md requires. Bundle roots carry no subtype, matching existing bundle fixtures.
Regenerated in place. All six bundle files are byte-identical to the pre-correction scratch output; each snapshot differs only by the added root subtype.
Re-validated all eight files and checked that every requested focus/expanded ID exists in its fixture and that cases.json hashes match the emitted bytes.
No layout, projection, metric or solver result was produced or inspected during these checks.
